pages.title: Besties Sunset Scooter Rider
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Put together outfits for an evening ride in Besties Sunset Scooter Rider. Help the friends choose clothing and accessories that suit their sunset scooter outing. Compare the wardrobe options for each character and finish both looks before they head out together.

pages.title: Reach 2048
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Slide numbered tiles around the board in Reach 2048. Equal values combine when they meet, creating a larger tile and opening space for further moves. Plan several slides ahead to reach 2048, then continue merging if you want to pursue a higher number.

pages.title: Ole Bunny
pages.creator: Sekip Games
pages.description: Guide a bunny along a circular route in Ole Bunny. Click to reverse its direction, collect the compass roses, and avoid the bulls sharing the path. Carrot-based abilities add further options as you look for a safe moment to pass each threat.

pages.title: Pipe Connect
pages.creator: Pidomtech
pages.description: Build a continuous water route in Pipe Connect. Rotate straight sections, bends, and junctions to join the available pipe pieces into a connected system. Check how each turn affects the next connection so the water has a route through the puzzle.

pages.title: About a Frog
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Explore a series of platforming levels as a frog in About a Frog. Jump between sections of the terrain and move past obstacles along the route. Reaching further into each stage depends on judging the next landing and keeping the frog clear of danger.

pages.title: Online Cats Multiplayer Park
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Join real-time cat challenges in Online Cats Multiplayer Park. Compete in a collection of modes built around running, jumping, guessing, and racing alongside other players. Each activity sets a different objective, including a ball-touching contest where successful touches earn points.

pages.title: My Tiny Land
pages.creator: FantasyTalk
pages.description: Clear produce from the board in My Tiny Land. Drag fruit and vegetables into the collection basket, bringing three matching items together to remove them. Plan which pieces to take next and empty the arrangement before the timer runs out.

pages.title: War Robots Battles
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Prepare combat machines for arena fights in War Robots Battles. Choose robot equipment, fit weapons, and assemble a team for the battles ahead. The combination of machines and firepower you bring determines the options available when facing the opposing force.

pages.title: Passenger Sort
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Get travelers onto the appropriate transport in Passenger Sort. Direct passengers toward their assigned buses, planes, or trains, working out the sequence needed to organize the group. Each arrangement turns boarding into a sorting puzzle with several travelers to place correctly.

pages.title: Mart Puzzle Shopping Sort
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Organize goods and complete customer requests in Mart Puzzle Shopping Sort. Sort the market's products into useful arrangements so shoppers can receive their orders. Work through each shopping puzzle by choosing which items to handle next and keeping the requested goods in mind.

pages.title: Merge Racer Stunts Car
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Combine identical vehicles into improved models in Merge Racer Stunts Car. Build up the available cars through merges, then use their upgraded performance in racing and stunt challenges. Choosing when to combine vehicles supports progress toward stronger cars for the next course.

pages.title: Epic Mine
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Dig toward the center of the earth in Epic Mine. Break through underground material, use dynamite, and deal with hidden monsters while searching for your missing friends. Organize ore smelting and resource sales, then invest in skills to support deeper mining expeditions.

pages.title: Solitaire Deluxe Edition
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Arrange playing cards and build the foundation piles in Solitaire Deluxe Edition. Move available cards around the layout and draw from the stock when another card is needed. Hint and undo options help you reconsider a position while working toward clearing the deal.

pages.title: Animerge
pages.creator: Ethos Games
pages.description: Combine small animals into larger creatures in Animerge. Drop matching animals together to advance through the sequence from tiny creatures toward an elephant. Use the cyclone option when rearranging the pile could help, and choose a different radio track while continuing the merge puzzle.

pages.title: Poptropica
pages.creator: Poptropica Limited
pages.description: Explore an island world and complete character quests in Poptropica. Customize your adventurer, pets, and clubhouse while meeting other characters along the way. Click near your character to walk, farther away to run, or above them to jump as you investigate each area.

pages.title: Noob Parkour 3D
pages.creator: PhenomenalGames
pages.description: Cross block-built obstacle courses in Noob Parkour 3D. Move with the keyboard, jump between sections, and interact with objects along the route. Careful positioning before each leap helps you reach the next platform and continue through the parkour challenges.

pages.title: Word Sprint
pages.creator: David Jalbert
pages.description: Find words against a two-minute clock in Word Sprint. Connect letters to form words of at least three characters, using bonus tiles and multipliers to increase the result. Accumulated points can buy power-ups or extra attempts for later word-finding runs.

pages.title: Idle Robots
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Assemble mechanical characters in Idle Robots. Work through a robot's construction one component at a time, selecting and adding the parts needed to complete it. Continue building through the available designs as each machine takes shape from its individual sections.

pages.title: Merge & Decor
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Restore a mansion by combining objects in Merge & Decor. Merge matching pieces into the tools and items needed for tasks, earning stars as you complete them. Spend those stars on renovation choices to change the appearance of the house.

pages.title: Block puzzle
pages.creator: MX Media & Entertainment Pte. Ltd
pages.description: Fit block shapes onto the grid in Block puzzle. Drag each piece into an open position and complete rows or columns to remove them. Leave room for the next shapes, since a useful placement now can keep later pieces from becoming impossible to fit.

pages.title: Parkour Rooftop
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Leap across buildings in Parkour Rooftop. Tap to jump, time each crossing, and avoid obstacles that interrupt the run. Successful landings lead into rolls and the next stretch of rooftop, keeping attention on the gap or barrier approaching ahead.

pages.title: Brain Master IQ Challenge
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Work through an assortment of unusual puzzles in Brain Master IQ Challenge. Examine each scene and interact with its objects to find a solution, including answers that require an unexpected approach. Finishing one challenge opens another problem with a different trick to work out.

pages.title: 2048 ABC Runner
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Race along a course by changing letter forms in 2048 ABC Runner. Select a shape that suits the section ahead and keep the character moving through the route. Different letters alter how the runner travels, making timely transformations central to reaching the finish.

pages.title: Line bright
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Guide a glowing line through geometric puzzles in Line bright. Move with the keyboard, navigate around hazards, and reach the crystal needed to finish the stage. Plan the route through each layout so the line can reach its goal without meeting an obstacle.

pages.title: Running Bot
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Run through a wintry landscape in Running Bot. Avoid trees and rocks while collecting Christmas gifts, health, and useful upgrades. Shields, magnets, and wings change what the robot can handle as you keep the run going and pursue a higher score.

pages.title: Drift City
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Slide cars through city streets in Drift City. Build drift points during drives and use your progress to unlock more vehicles. Explore the city with steering, handbrake, and nitro controls while working through the game's achievement challenges.

pages.title: Kisiy Misiy
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide Kisiy Misiy through ten obstacle-filled stages to reach their flags. Move with the keyboard or touch controls and judge the route past each danger. Completing one course leads to another set of platforms and hazards for the character to cross.

pages.title: Ellie Get Ready with Me 2
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: Help Ellie prepare for the day in Ellie Get Ready with Me 2. Work through hair washing and facial care before applying makeup. Finish by choosing an outfit, bringing the separate care and styling stages together into her completed daily look.

pages.title: Back to school Fashionistas
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: Choose school-day looks for the princesses in Back to school Fashionistas. Browse clothing and accessories, then put together an outfit for each character. Customize the blackboard as another part of the scene before completing the group's return-to-school styling session.

pages.title: Puzzle Blocks
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Fill the board completely in Puzzle Blocks. Move the colored shapes into the grid, finding positions that leave no empty gaps. Work out how the pieces fit together across fifty levels, where the space remaining after each placement shapes your next decision.

pages.title: Japanese Racing Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Assemble vehicle photographs in Japanese Racing Cars Jigsaw. Choose a Japanese-car image and decide whether to use twenty-four, forty-eight, or one hundred pieces. Match the edges and bodywork details to reconnect the scattered sections into a complete racing-car picture.

pages.title: Numblocks Hunter
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Stop approaching number blocks in Numblocks Hunter. Solve the arithmetic question associated with a block in the front line to clear the matching row. Keep answering accurately as the blocks advance toward the base and reduce the room available for mistakes.

pages.title: Color Wheel
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: React to a rotating color challenge in Color Wheel. Turn the wheel left or right to bring the appropriate color into position at the required moment. Watch the changing arrangement and keep matching accurately as the sequence continues.

pages.title: Drunken Duel 2
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Face a rooftop gun duel in Drunken Duel 2. Play alone or against a friend, controlling the orange or blue fighter as the characters wobble through the battle. Shooting the helicopter can send it onto a rival, and five round wins decide the match.

pages.title: Perfect Sniper 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Eliminate marked threats from a distance in Perfect Sniper 3D. Aim carefully with the mouse and fire at enemies across each scene. Explosive objects provide another way to deal with opponents when their positions make a direct shot less useful.

pages.title: Pregnant Kardashians
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Create maternity-themed outfits in Pregnant Kardashians. Choose clothing and accessories for the game's four celebrity-inspired characters, comparing combinations as you style each one. Complete their individual looks with pieces selected from the available wardrobes.

pages.title: Super RunCraft
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Run through a block-built world in Super RunCraft. Collect coins and useful items such as a hoverboard while avoiding obstacles along the route. Keep reacting to the terrain ahead to extend the endless run and gather more pickups before it ends.

pages.title: Dolphin Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Add colors to dolphin drawings in Dolphin Coloring Book. Choose a picture and apply the colors you want to its different areas, building the scene a section at a time. The pictures can also be printed for coloring away from the screen.

pages.title: Zombie Shoot
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Fire a bazooka at zombies positioned around each stage in Zombie Shoot. Send explosive shells along a useful trajectory so they detonate near the enemies. Adjust the aim and account for the shell's movement when a direct line to a zombie is blocked.

pages.title: Happy Shopping Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Reassemble shopping-themed pictures in Happy Shopping Jigsaw. Move scattered pieces into their matching positions, comparing colors, edges, and details from the scene. Continue joining sections until the chosen image is complete, then select another shopping picture to put together.

pages.title: Military Vehicles Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Match military vehicles in Military Vehicles Match 3. Arrange three or more matching pieces together to remove them and increase the score. Keep forming combinations while watching the side gauge, since the attempt ends if that meter drops to zero.

pages.title: Rich Huat
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Clear matching fish from the board in Rich Huat. Select groups of identical fish to remove them and create a different arrangement for the next move. Look for useful clusters as you continue the fish-themed block-clearing puzzle and build the score.

pages.title: Block Craft
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Create your own structures in the block-based sandbox of Block Craft. Choose materials from the available block types and reshape the surrounding world with the building tools. Move through the environment to expand your construction from another angle or begin a new part of the kingdom.

pages.title: Robot In Battle Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Reveal matching robot pictures in Robot In Battle Memory. Turn over cards, remember the images you find, and return to them when a matching partner appears. Clear the pairs across four levels while trying to finish with fewer moves.

pages.title: Motorbike Track Day
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose a motorcycle for a stunt-filled ride in Motorbike Track Day. Take police bikes or dirt bikes onto the map and control them through its racing and stunt sections. Use the boost when you need more speed, adjusting your steering for the terrain ahead.

pages.title: Chop Hand
pages.creator: ConchGame
pages.description: Grab cash without losing a hand in Chop Hand. Watch the guillotine's movement and choose the moment to reach for the money. Pull off successful grabs between the falling blade's passes, since a badly timed attempt puts the hand directly in danger.

pages.title: Slime Maker
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Make a customized batch of slime in Slime Maker. Combine the ingredients, work through the mixing steps, and choose a color for the result. Add decorations to change its appearance and finish the slime with the details you prefer.

pages.title: Planet Repair Squad
pages.creator: Neuronality
pages.description: Protect an ecosystem from industrial damage in Planet Repair Squad. Pilot a UFO to rescue animals, fish, and trees, and carry factory pollution away into space. Keep the environment in balance as the years pass and the factories continue putting pressure on the planet.

pages.title: Mech Battle Simulator
pages.creator: Best Games Studios
pages.description: Arrange a robotic army in Mech Battle Simulator. Position units such as mechs, tanks, robot spiders, and buggies, then send them into battle. Watch how the forces collide and adjust the deployment to improve the outcome of the next simulated fight.

pages.title: Mage Girl Adventure
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Guide a young mage through a 2D adventure in Mage Girl Adventure. Cross the valley's platforms, deal with its challenges, and collect stars along the way. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to move through each stage of the journey.

pages.title: Christmas Gifts Match 3
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Match festive presents in Christmas Gifts Match 3. Bring matching gift pieces together to clear them from the board and earn points. Watch the arrangement created by each match and look for another combination to continue the Christmas-themed puzzle.

pages.title: Cute Bat Memory
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find pairs of bat illustrations in Cute Bat Memory. Flip a card to reveal its picture, then choose another and check for a match. Remember previously revealed positions to clear the board more efficiently instead of relying on another guess.

pages.title: Pixel Force
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Enter a first-person deathmatch in Pixel Force. Move through the pixel-style combat area and eliminate as many opponents as possible. Use the mouse to fire or aim through the scope, choosing your shots while watching for enemies around the map.

pages.title: Impossible Truck Stunt Parking
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drive a large truck along narrow stunt routes in Impossible Truck Stunt Parking. Keep the vehicle on the course and reach the designated parking position to finish the assignment. Manage steering and braking carefully where the route leaves little room for an error.

pages.title: Watermelon Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Aim at fruit targets in Watermelon Shooter. Use the firearm to break the watermelons presented in each shooting stage, tracking their positions before firing. Complete the required targets to advance through levels with different arrangements of objects to hit.

pages.title: Dragon io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take a dragon into aerial multiplayer combat in Dragon io. Fly around the arena, attack opponents with fireballs or fire breath, and use a sprint to dodge incoming danger. Adjust your height as well as your direction when pursuing another dragon or escaping its attack.

pages.title: MTB Hill Bike Rider
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Ride a mountain bike along uneven trails in MTB Hill Bike Rider. Follow twisting routes uphill and downhill, adjusting the bike's movement as the slope changes. Keeping control through the bends and rough sections helps you continue farther along the mountain course.

pages.title: Angry Bull Racing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Race a charging bull in Angry Bull Racing. Guide it toward the finish, sprint when you need extra speed, and attack rival bulls during the contest. Choose from the available bull appearances before returning to another race against the other animals.

pages.title: Hill Climber
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Drive over a series of bumps and slopes in Hill Climber. Balance acceleration with reversing so the vehicle can continue across the uneven ground. Try to travel farther on each attempt, watching how changes in speed affect the car's position on the hills.

pages.title: Biker Lane
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guide a motorcycle to the flag in Biker Lane. Accelerate, brake, and tilt the bike to handle the route, panning the view when you need to inspect what lies ahead. Faster finishes earn stars that can unlock additional riders.

pages.title: Free Fall 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Steer a falling character past obstacles in Free Fall 2. Shift its position during the descent to find a clear route through the barriers. Keep the fall going to build your score, reacting to the next obstacle before it reaches your path.

pages.title: Stickman Ragdoll
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Launch a stick figure into physics-driven crashes in Stickman Ragdoll. Choose a setup and send the character through the course, with vehicles available for different attempts. Impacts, flips, time in the air, and broken vehicle parts contribute to the resulting score.

pages.title: Super Doll Pregnant Check Up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help with a virtual pregnancy appointment in Super Doll Pregnant Check Up. Use the available tools to check temperature, listen to the heartbeat, measure the belly, and perform an ultrasound. Work through the care steps and finish the visit with vitamins for the character.

pages.title: Foot Shot
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Kick footballs toward targets inside the goal in Foot Shot. Adjust the shot so it reaches the marked area rather than merely entering the net. Successful hits add points and present another target, while missed attempts use up the remaining balls.

pages.title: Wild West Slot Machine
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Spin a Western-themed slot machine in Wild West Slot Machine. Set up a round and watch the reels stop on their symbols, checking the result against the game's winning combinations. Continue with the available in-game balance as you explore the slot-machine rounds.

pages.title: Las Vegas Roulette
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Place virtual chips on a roulette table in Las Vegas Roulette. Choose numbers or groups on the betting layout, then spin the wheel and watch where the ball settles. The result determines how the game's chip balance changes before the next round.

pages.title: Hunter Training
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Practice rifle aiming in Hunter Training. Select a gun and take on a sequence of shooting targets, lining up the sights before firing. Work through the training levels by meeting their target requirements and adjusting to the placement of each new challenge.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Hawaii
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Piece together island scenery in Jigsaw Puzzle Hawaii. Choose from sixteen landscape pictures and reconnect the scattered sections to restore the selected view. Use shorelines, colors, and other image details to identify where neighboring pieces belong.

pages.title: Candy Slide
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Open a way out for the red block in Candy Slide. Slide the blue blocks around the board to clear its exit route, completing each arrangement in as few moves as possible. Work through twenty-four layouts that require different sequences of shifts.

pages.title: Waffle Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Make words from a grid of letters in Waffle Game. Connect letters into valid words and add to the score before the two-minute limit expires. Keep scanning for another combination as the available time shrinks and each found word advances the attempt.

pages.title: Furious Adventure 2 trap
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: Cross a trap-filled platform course in Furious Adventure 2 trap. Move and jump through the retro-style stages, judging where to land before continuing. Reaching the next section requires working around the level's hazards rather than rushing into the first open space.

pages.title: Gold Miner
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Retrieve gold with a swinging hook in Gold Miner. Release the line when it points toward a valuable nugget and wait for the catch to return. Meet the level's earnings target before time expires to continue to another mining round.

pages.title: Pregnant Kitty Spa
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Give a feline character a care-and-styling session in Pregnant Kitty Spa. Work through the spa treatments, apply makeup, and choose clothing for her finished look. Select the available items at each stage to take the kitty from the first treatment to the completed outfit.

pages.title: Paper Dash
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Guide a character through a paper-styled platform world in Paper Dash. Jump through each stage and collect stars along the route, building progress toward additional levels. Watch the gaps between landing areas so the journey continues without a fall.
